category_title: Active and physically competent children with speech and developmental delays
minimal_context: The student is playing football in the hallway with his older cousin and father.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to play football in the hallway now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Play football shall we? Right chaps, run!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please pass the ball to me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Right. Yeah. (He verbally directs where the tutor should stand instead of passing the ball.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am standing here. Go ahead and pass it now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (He ignores the instruction, concentrating fully on his own physical skills. Supremely confident in the familiar activity, he keeps the ball to himself, kicking, blocking, and tackling with skill while varying the pressure of his kicks.)

TUTOR: We are going to play football in the hallway now.

STUDENT: Play football shall we? Right chaps, run!

TUTOR: Please pass the ball to me.

STUDENT: Right. Yeah. (He verbally directs where the tutor should stand instead of passing the ball.)

TUTOR: I am standing here. Go ahead and pass it now.

STUDENT: (He ignores the instruction, concentrating fully on his own physical skills. Supremely confident in the familiar activity, he keeps the ball to himself, kicking, blocking, and tackling with skill while varying the pressure of his kicks.)

context.social_setting: with his older cousin and father

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When engaging in a familiar activity where he is supremely confident
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: kicks, blocks and tackles with skill, varying the pressure of his kicks and concentrating fully

behavior_patterns.condition: When playing independently without adult commentary
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: verbally directs his cousin to where she should stand, but concentrates fully on physical skills
